verses.text: If someone brings a peace offering from the cattle, male or female, it must have nothing wrong with it when he offers it to the LORD.
He will put his hand on the head of the animal and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron's sons, the priests, will splash the blood all around the altar.
From the peace offering he will bring a gift made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the inside parts, and all the fat on the inside parts,
the two kidneys with the fat on them near the lower back, and the fatty covering of the liver. He will remove these with the kidneys.
Aaron's sons will burn it on the altar, on top of the burnt offering on the wood on the fire. It is a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
If his peace offering to the LORD is from the flock, male or female, it must have nothing wrong with it.
If he brings a lamb, he will offer it in front of the LORD.
He will put his hand on its head and kill it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron's sons will splash its blood all around the altar.

From the peace offering he will bring a gift made by fire to the LORD: its fat, the whole fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the fat that covers the inside parts, and all the fat on the inside parts,
the two kidneys with the fat on them near the lower back, and the fatty covering of the liver. He will remove these with the kidneys.
The priest will burn it on the altar. It is food, a gift made by fire to the LORD.
If his offering is a goat, he will offer it in front of the LORD.
He will put his hand on its head and kill it in front of the Tent of Meeting. The sons of Aaron will splash its blood all around the altar.
From it he will bring his gift made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the inside parts, and all the fat on the inside parts,
the two kidneys with the fat on them near the lower back, and the fatty covering of the liver. He will remove these with the kidneys.
The priest will burn them on the altar. It is food, a gift made by fire, with a pleasing smell. All the fat belongs to the LORD.
This is a rule forever, for all your people after you, wherever you live: Do not eat any fat or any blood."
